description: This file implements classes and methods related to Dobby container management within the WPEFramework, including container creation, destruction, status checks, and interactions with the Dobby daemon via IPC and proxy objects.

classes.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing Dobby containers, providing methods to create, destroy, and monitor containers, and interfacing with the Dobby daemon via IPC.

classes.name: DobbyContainer
classes.description: Represents a Dobby container instance, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status, and handling container-specific information and JSON parsing.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DobbyContainerAdministrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on configuration files found in specified search paths.

methods.name: DestroyContainer
methods.description: Stops and removes a container by name, waiting for it to stop asynchronously.

methods.name: ContainerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a container with the given name is already running.

methods.name: containerStopCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, used to fulfill promises waiting for container stop events.
